name: Azure Beastbinder — "If it's a creature, it also has base power and toughness 2/2"
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). Fired, the rider's "it" is written out as "up to one target artifact, creature, or planeswalker an opponent controls"; the commas of that list kept the rider from getting a line of its own, so its condition gated the whole line (an artifact target kept its abilities) and the base-P/T parser turned the long subject away (a creature target kept its P/T). Serra Angel becomes 2/2 with no abilities; Sol Ring loses its abilities and gets no P/T.
